With the representation library, the new representation is a table, tree, or Venn diagram drawn with `diagram`.

actions.intent: Show both conditionals share a numerator
actions.latex: P(A \mid B) = \frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(B)}, \quad P(B \mid A) = \frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(A)}

actions.text: Both conditionals have the same numerator, P(A and B), but they divide by different things: P(A|B) divides by P(B) and P(B|A) divides by P(A). So they're equal only when P(A) = P(B). Conditioning changes which group you measure the overlap against.

board.text: Why isn't P(A|B) the same as P(B|A)?
